textRuns.value: Why this page exists: supervisors hand-enter source data in Excel, so casing and naming drift is expected, not exceptional. This is an interim backstop for checks not yet wired into the pipeline -- assert_no_orphaned_client_kp and assert_no_unmapped_kp_sku both exist on disk but are not referenced by any model's audits() block -- not a permanent replacement for those audits.
